headline: Khaitan & Co, Hogan Lovells Cadwalader act on ideaForge ₹500 crore QIP
sum: ideaForge Technology Limited has raised ₹500 crore from a Qualified Institutional Placement of equity shares. Khaitan & Co advised ideaForge Technology and the Lead Managers, JM Financial Limited and IIFL Capital Services Limited on this…
detail: ideaForge Technology Limited has raised ₹500 crore from a Qualified Institutional Placement of equity shares. Khaitan & Co advised ideaForge Technology and the Lead Managers, JM Financial Limited and IIFL Capital Services Limited on this QIP. The transaction team included Gautham Srinivas (Partner), Sathvik Ponnappa (Partner), Vaishnavi Gupta (Senior Associate), Associates Anubhav Jaiswal, Sarvesh Sharma, Shambhavi Gautam, Vidushi Tanya and Rishav Khetan. Gautham Srinivas, Sathvik Ponnappa Hogan Lovells Cadwalader served as the international legal counsel for the lead managers.
